methodological_rule: An editorial Spanish title can establish the semantic topic/proposition of the Rarámuri title as a whole but cannot establish which Rarámuri word corresponds to which Spanish word. Syntactic reordering, paraphrase and free translation remain possible.
research_value: The alignments provide controlled contextual envelopes for pre-1980 -game/-ame strings.

They allow candidate word-level hypotheses to be generated, but such hypotheses must be tested against a dictionary, grammar, parallel sentence or recovered original page before promotion to confirmed gloss.
The 1972, 1974 and 1975 items are authored by Albino Mares Trías, providing a community-authored Western usage layer despite editorial mediation.
next_steps: Recover the downloadable PDFs or page images where possible.
Use independently analyzed Western Rarámuri texts to test candidate meanings of e'carúgame, nehualíame, me'líame, ajágame, muchígame and nerúgame.
Build a token-level concordance only after full text is available.
